record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, truncate observed histories to the most recent 64 positions instead of 128, reserving the final position for the appended mask at inference. Retain chronological nonpadding position ranks and the masked-position readout. Most histories fit within 64 positions; removing distant context may reduce interference. Keep positional-table shape, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed, and apply the same history policy in training and the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, limit sequences to the most recent 64 positions to reduce distant-context interference. Inference reserves the final position for the appended mask, retaining up to 63 observed items. Preserve chronological nonpadding positions, masked-state readout, positional-table shapes, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer.
